verification.notes: The public episode transcript directly confirms that Youssef accused Jake Tapper of discussing what Youssef called fake rape stories every day while never discussing the cited Israeli-media reports. CNN transcripts independently show Tapper repeatedly covered October 7 sexual-violence allegations, including in December 2023 and February, March, and April 2024. However, 'every single day' is rhetorical and an exhaustive negative claim that he never covered any relevant Israeli-media reporting could not be established from targeted transcript searches. The accusation as made is confirmed, but its sweeping frequency and omission claims are not.
